method: Manual visual review of every race-labelled clip thumbnail (numbered contact sheets per group). Pexels descriptions are race-neutral, so labels were checked by eye. Clips whose people cannot be identified keep no race label and are only used for the All Races option. People-free clips (the fallback pool) were reviewed separately: any clip showing a person, arm or hands was removed from that pool.
